title: Teaching 2004 - 2015
text:
I taught new programmers with University and College backgrounds how to apply their skill-sets towards our company projects. My courses were designed to place all new programmers at the same level before allowing them access to the main code repository.

My Coarse

Custom build data Structures
  • Vector
  • LinkList
  • HashTable
  • Binary Tree
Sorting Algorithms
  • Insertion
  • Bubble
  • Quick
Design Patterns
  • Singlton
  • Observer
  • MVC
  • Factory
OOD
  • Custom GUI components
  • SQL and Entities
  • Abstract layers
  • Encapsulation versus Inheritance
The end project was a choice of
  • Procedural Fractal Terrain Generator
  • Particle Editor
  • 3D Software Pipeline
